title: 都问AI泡沫破不破：格里芬却盯住定价能力，模型能要价多高？
speaker: Ken Griffin

segments.en: So what we don't know is how,
segments.zh: 我们不知道的是，

segments.en: as these models become more intelligent,
segments.zh: 随着这些模型变得更智能，

segments.en: how much are they able to demand extremely high pricing,
segments.zh: 它们能在多大程度上要求极高的定价，

segments.en: because they help to actually solve the problems
segments.zh: 因为它们能帮助真正解决

segments.en: that have vexed humanity for centuries.
segments.zh: 困扰人类几个世纪的问题。

segments.en: Because people don't know the answer to that,
segments.zh: 因为人们不知道答案，

segments.en: often the conversation goes to this bubble one,
segments.zh: 所以讨论常常转向泡沫论，

segments.en: that maybe this is a bubble.
segments.zh: 也许这是个泡沫。

segments.en: Radalio thinks it is.
segments.zh: 拉达里奥认为是。

segments.en: Howard Mark says he's on bubble watch.
segments.zh: 霍华德·马克斯说他正在观察泡沫。

segments.en: The BIS says that it has echoes of the dot-com boom.
segments.zh: 国际清算银行称其与互联网泡沫有相似之处。

segments.en: And I wonder whether it is notable if this is a bubble.
segments.zh: 我想知道，如果这是泡沫，是否值得注意。

segments.en: And if you have any particular thoughts about that,
segments.zh: 以及你对此有何具体看法，

segments.en: if it is a bubble and if it's one that looks like it's going
segments.zh: 如果这是泡沫，而且看起来可能

segments.en: to burst at least in certain parts
segments.zh: 至少在某些部分会破裂，

segments.en: of the different AI layers.
segments.zh: 在不同AI层面。

segments.en: Well, so the big picture is there's almost certainly
segments.zh: 嗯，总体来看，几乎可以肯定

segments.en: bubbles within this moment in time.
segments.zh: 在当前时刻存在泡沫。

segments.en: And any radical transformation of our economy
segments.zh: 任何经济的根本性转型

segments.en: is generally intertwined with a bubble.
segments.zh: 通常都与泡沫交织在一起。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。
